title: AI for Medical Research & Literature Review
subtitle: Search, screen and summarise the medical literature faster with AI research assistants — while keeping your methods rigorous.
description: A practical guide to using AI research tools for literature searching, screening abstracts, summarising papers, extracting data and drafting manuscripts. You will learn to verify every citation, avoid fabricated references, and stay within journal and ethics-committee rules on AI use.
audience: Clinicians and researchers preparing reviews, theses or audits
Pharmacists and allied health professionals involved in research
outcomes: Build better search strategies with AI support
Screen and summarise papers efficiently and transparently
Follow journal policies on disclosing AI use

modules.title: The AI research toolkit
modules.description: What different research assistants do well.
